description: Goodsaegim makes custom goods — acrylic keyrings, acrylic stands, stickers, postcards, photo cards and more — in small runs starting from a single piece. Ideal for fan merch, artist goods, and one-off gifts made from your own artwork. Chat to pick a product and options (size, quantity, accessories), get a real-time quote with VAT and shipping included, and once the spec is settled receive links that take you through artwork upload and payment. Your file is checked for print readiness before production. Made in Korea by the manufacturer itself; ships within Korea only. Covers 11 products with option info, quotes, and order links.
